name: Neutral Milk Hotel
label: Merge
lede: Two albums, one tour that nearly broke its singer, fifteen years of silence, and a record that kept selling the whole time nobody was looking.

eras.title: Four-track tapes in Ruston
eras.text: In Ruston, Louisiana, a handful of teenagers traded home-recorded cassettes and invented a record label, Elephant 6, before any of them had a record. Jeff Mangum drifted from bands with friends to solo tapes as Milk, then left town and kept moving.

years.h: Jeff Mangum starts recording alone in Ruston as Milk
years.p: Jeff Mangum, son of a Louisiana Tech economics professor, makes four-track tapes as Milk. He trades cassettes with [[Robert Schneider|c7c1a16f-65df-47cb-8b03-5b7bcfc7d2ef]], [[Will Cullen Hart|312cf9d4-3d9e-4fbf-9de6-cc358dc3e6e6]] and [[Bill Doss|202b04ad-7c13-4955-b0a2-5ca90371aedf]], who share his taste for the [[Minutemen|d4ad0149-d8ae-4105-8009-0221fce9ff35]], John Cage and 1960s psychedelia.
years.xp:
Before Milk, Mangum and Will Cullen Hart played together in a punk band called Maggot and an experimental pop project called Cranberry Lifecycle. The four friends dreamed up the Elephant 6 Recording Company as a pretend label for their tapes; it became a real collective a few years later in Athens, Georgia.

Mangum switched to Neutral Milk Hotel after learning another band was already called Milk.

years.h: From Athens to the road, and Hype City Soundtrack
years.p: After a spell in Athens, Georgia, in Synthetic Flying Machine with Bill Doss and Will Cullen Hart, Jeff Mangum takes off for Denver, Los Angeles and Seattle. On the way he makes the Hype City Soundtrack demo tape as Neutral Milk Hotel.
years.xp: Synthetic Flying Machine turned into [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]], with Mangum on drums, vocals and sound effects. Wikipedia also lists him as bassist in Robert Schneider's [[The Apples in Stereo|ea075268-e5ea-40f7-b9c3-68b039218a88]] in this stretch.

years.h: Everything Is 7-inch on Seattle's Cher Doll Records
years.p: Jeff Mangum's first proper Neutral Milk Hotel single comes out on Cher Doll Records while he's living in Seattle. Wikipedia says it's what convinced him to keep the project going.

years.h: [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]] release California Demise
years.p: The Olivia Tremor Control's debut EP, with Jeff Mangum drumming, is one of the first records to carry the Elephant 6 Recording Co. name.

eras.title: A diary, a studio in Denver
eras.text: The first album is basically Jeff Mangum and Robert Schneider in Schneider's Pet Sounds Studio in Denver. It sold about five thousand copies, and it was enough to make Mangum want a real band.

years.h: Jeff Mangum reads Anne Frank's diary and cries for three days
years.p: Jeff Mangum reads The Diary of a Young Girl and spends about three days crying, dreaming of going back in time to save Anne Frank. The book will shape Holland, 1945 and much of the next album.

years.h: Recording On Avery Island at Pet Sounds Studio, Denver
years.p: Jeff Mangum plays guitar, drums, organs and tapes on a four-track reel-to-reel; [[Robert Schneider|c7c1a16f-65df-47cb-8b03-5b7bcfc7d2ef]] adds fuzz bass, organ and horn arrangements. Trombonist Rick Benjamin guests.

years.h: On Avery Island, Neutral Milk Hotel's debut on Merge
years.p: Merge puts out Jeff Mangum's first LP; Fire Records follows in the UK on September 30. It sells about 5,000 copies and lands at No. 35 in the Village Voice's Pazz & Jop poll.
years.xp: The record closes with a thirteen-minute drone piece built from gamelan and noise ideas. The song Naomi is named for [[Naomi Yang|40b46c2d-5792-4eb4-90d0-e07aa0676479]] of [[Galaxie 500|4de3cfed-b459-42bd-bfbb-7a843fbc73df]]. Mangum and Lisa Janssen made the US cover; Fire commissioned a different one from Jill Carnes.

years.h: A tape swap, a letter and a pizza shop build the band
years.p: [[Julian Koster|5a4afc38-aa20-457e-9ca8-26d62dc1f945]] joins after trading demo tapes with Jeff Mangum. [[Jeremy Barnes|e66bf4cf-011b-4279-a83b-7476f981022b]] quits DePaul University in Chicago to drum, and [[Scott Spillane|ed77bb86-b345-436d-89bc-b721571906de]] is found at a pizza shop in Austin, Texas.
years.xp: Barnes got the job after writing Koster a long, introspective letter. The new band moved into Koster's grandmother's house in New York City to rehearse.

eras.title: Carnival on AM radio
eras.text: One summer in Denver produced In the Aeroplane Over the Sea. The tour that followed was loud, chaotic and exhausting, and by the end of 1998 Jeff Mangum wanted out without ever quite saying so.

years.h: First Neutral Milk Hotel band show: Brownies, East Village
years.p: The new four-piece plays its first gig at Brownies in New York's East Village. The tour money pays for a move to Athens, Georgia, where the rest of Elephant 6 lives.

years.h: Lance Bangs tapes Jeff Mangum solo at Jittery Joe's
years.p: Filmmaker Lance Bangs records Jeff Mangum playing alone at Jittery Joe's coffee shop in Athens. The tape stays in a drawer until 2001.

years.cap: Robert Schneider's Pet Sounds Studio, Denver.
years.h: No distortion pedals: how Aeroplane got its sound
years.p: At Pet Sounds Studio, [[Robert Schneider|c7c1a16f-65df-47cb-8b03-5b7bcfc7d2ef]] gets the album's warm fuzz from heavy compression, a Bellari tube preamp and cassette tape pushed into the red, not effects boxes. Jeff Mangum sits by the control room.
years.xp: Schneider tried electric guitar on some songs and then wiped it, preferring Mangum's acoustic, miked with Neumann U 87s. He wrote the horn parts; [[Scott Spillane|ed77bb86-b345-436d-89bc-b721571906de]] rewrote the trumpet lines from treble to bass clef so he could read them, then piled his own rowdy counter-lines on top.

years.h: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea · Merge
years.p: Merge presses 5,500 CDs and 1,600 LPs. Early sales look like On Avery Island's all over again.
years.xp:
Chris Bilheimer, who was designing for [[R.E.M.|ea4dfa26-f633-4da6-a52a-f49ea4897b58]] at the time, built the cover from a thrift-shop postcard of bathers; the woman on the dock has a drumhead where her face should be. Brian Dewan drew the inside art, including the flying phonograph.

Reviews were split. Pitchfork gave it 8.7 and CMJ called it the best album of 1998. Rolling Stone gave it one star, and Robert Christgau called it a funereal jape.
play: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea

years.h: Jeff Mangum keeps throwing Julian Koster into the drums
years.p: Neutral Milk Hotel's North American and European shows are physical: Wikipedia says Mangum often threw Julian Koster into the drum kit. [[Laura Carter|f8a48346-1ad8-4761-9ea3-9ddc4ade094c]] works as the band's mixing-desk translator for baffled house engineers.
years.xp: John Fernandes and Will Westbrook join the tour to cover the horn parts.

years.h: Holland, 1945 comes out as a 7-inch single
years.p: Holland, 1945, the song Jeff Mangum built out of Anne Frank's story, gets a single release. It's the last new Neutral Milk Hotel record for more than a decade.

years.h: Jeff Mangum's New Year's Eve solo set at the 40 Watt Club
years.p: After the tour, Jeff Mangum plays a solo set at the 40 Watt Club in Athens. Nobody announces a breakup. The band simply stops.
years.xp: Band members said later that Mangum kept saying he wanted to quit without explaining why. He told interviewers his basic assumptions about reality started crumbling, that he hoarded rice for Y2K and shut himself away for days.

eras.title: I am a person
eras.text: Jeff Mangum vanished from view while the record he'd left behind found a second life online. The less he said, the more people cared, and the other three kept busy in A Hawk and a Hacksaw, The Music Tapes and The Gerbils.

years.h: In New Zealand, Jeff Mangum talks about a breakdown
years.p: Playing with [[Chris Knox|77a29700-a307-4568-8063-be553ae062e6]] as World of Wild Beards, Jeff Mangum tells the crowd he hasn't been onstage in three years after a complete nervous breakdown, according to Wikipedia.

years.h: Bulgarian field recordings, and Live at Jittery Joe's
years.p: Jeff Mangum releases Orange Twin Field Works: Volume I, Bulgarian folk recordings, on [[Laura Carter|f8a48346-1ad8-4761-9ea3-9ddc4ade094c]]'s Orange Twin label. The 1997 Jittery Joe's solo tape comes out too.

years.h: Pitchfork asks about a third album. Jeff Mangum isn't sure
years.p: Jeff Mangum tells Pitchfork his path feels different now. That summer he hosts shows on WFMU, playing musique concrète, music therapy tapes and folk field recordings.

q: I'm not an idea. I am a person.
years.h: A reporter tracks Jeff Mangum down. Mangum emails back
years.p: Creative Loafing writer Kevin Griffis goes looking for Jeff Mangum. The reply he gets is a polite request to be left alone.
years.xp:
By then In the Aeroplane Over the Sea had become the kind of record people passed to friends like a secret. Fans filled the silence with hoax blog posts announcing tours that didn't exist.

Pitchfork's Mark Richardson later argued the absence was the engine: with Mangum out of reach, the only connection left was the record and the other fans who loved it.

years.h: Domino reissue, and Pitchfork gives Aeroplane a 10
years.p: Domino reissues In the Aeroplane Over the Sea in the UK and Pitchfork's Mark Richardson scores it a perfect 10.0. Pitchfork had already moved it from No. 85 to No. 4 on its 1990s list in 2003.

years.h: Jeff Mangum marries filmmaker [[Astra Taylor|a685aa4a-4025-47f2-adf0-2a41d8ea7fff]]
years.p: Jeff Mangum marries documentary filmmaker and activist Astra Taylor. She'll be onstage with him on guitar and accordion when Neutral Milk Hotel returns.

years.h: Jeff Mangum sings with Olivia Tremor Control at the Bowery
years.p: Jeff Mangum walks onstage at the Bowery Ballroom in New York to sing I Have Been Floated with [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]].

years.h: Aeroplane is the sixth best-selling vinyl LP of 2008
years.p: A decade after its release, In the Aeroplane Over the Sea is selling about 25,000 copies a year, per Slate, and is among the records driving the vinyl revival.

years.h: Jeff Mangum reappears on the Elephant 6 Holiday Surprise tour
years.p: Jeff Mangum sings the Neutral Milk Hotel song Engine at several Holiday Surprise shows, with [[Julian Koster|5a4afc38-aa20-457e-9ca8-26d62dc1f945]] on singing saw. It's his first public appearance in about three years.

eras.title: Put the cameras away
eras.text: Jeff Mangum came back slowly: a benefit, a loft party, a protest, a festival he curated himself. Then the full band returned for a world tour with one strict house rule, no photos, and ended it on their own terms.

years.h: Jeff Mangum plays a benefit for [[Chris Knox|77a29700-a307-4568-8063-be553ae062e6]] in New York
years.p: At Le Poisson Rouge, Jeff Mangum plays acoustic Neutral Milk Hotel songs to raise money for Chris Knox, the New Zealand musician who had coaxed him onstage in 2001.

years.h: A Neutral Milk Hotel vinyl box set, sold by Mangum himself
years.p: Through his site Walking Wall of Words, Jeff Mangum self-releases a vinyl box set that includes the unreleased Ferris Wheel on Fire EP. Part of the money goes to charities including Children of the Blue Sky.

years.h: Jeff Mangum plays Occupy Wall Street in Zuccotti Park
years.p: Unannounced, Jeff Mangum sits down in Zuccotti Park and plays several songs for the Occupy Wall Street protesters. Phone videos are everywhere within a day.

years.h: Jeff Mangum raises $16,500 for an animal sanctuary
years.p: Jeff Mangum, a vegan, plays a benefit for the Woodstock Farm Animal Sanctuary in upstate New York that raises more than $16,500.

years.h: Jeff Mangum curates All Tomorrow's Parties in Minehead
years.p: Jeff Mangum fills an ATP weekend in Minehead, England, with Elephant 6 friends ([[The Apples in Stereo|ea075268-e5ea-40f7-b9c3-68b039218a88]], [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]], [[The Music Tapes|11e5be8b-e420-43ff-a8fc-87d8336db556]], [[A Hawk and a Hacksaw|b7cef615-5d43-463f-9032-5d3bc0d96b7f]]) plus [[The Fall|d5da1841-9bc8-4813-9f89-11098090148e]], [[Thurston Moore|8ba48525-d922-42ee-9775-97b7b8f9712e]], the Sun Ra Arkestra and [[The Magnetic Fields|3ff72a59-f39d-411d-9f93-2d4a86413013]].

years.h: Neutral Milk Hotel announce a reunion with all four members
years.p: Jeff Mangum, Julian Koster, Jeremy Barnes and Scott Spillane will tour for the first time in fifteen years. [[Robert Schneider|c7c1a16f-65df-47cb-8b03-5b7bcfc7d2ef]] says he'd known for seven years this was coming.

years.cap: Neutral Milk Hotel live at Celebrate Brooklyn during the reunion tour. Wikimedia Commons
years.h: First full show in 15 years, in a Baltimore church
years.p: Neutral Milk Hotel play 2640, a former Methodist church turned arts space in Baltimore. Photographers are told, gently but firmly, to put their cameras away.
years.xp: Mangum opened alone before the full band crashed in with The Fool. [[Astra Taylor|a685aa4a-4025-47f2-adf0-2a41d8ea7fff]], Jeremy Thal and Elf Power's [[Laura Carter|f8a48346-1ad8-4761-9ea3-9ddc4ade094c]] filled out the stage. Spin called it ragged and glorious; no new songs were played.

years.h: Aeroplane passes 393,000 copies without ever charting
years.p: According to Wikipedia, In the Aeroplane Over the Sea has sold more than 393,000 copies by 2013, without once appearing on the Billboard 200.

years.h: Neutral Milk Hotel call spring 2015 their last tour
years.p: The band announces that its spring 2015 run will be the last for the foreseeable future, and thanks everyone who came out.

years.h: Last Neutral Milk Hotel show: the Phoenix Theater, Petaluma
years.p: About twenty months after Baltimore, Neutral Milk Hotel play their final show at the Phoenix Theater in Petaluma, California.

eras.title: Everything in one box
eras.text: With no band left to tour, Merge gathered the whole Neutral Milk Hotel story in one place, down to the coffee-shop tape. The box got Grammy attention the original records never did.

years.h: The Collected Works of Neutral Milk Hotel box set
years.p: The box gathers both albums, the EPs and Live at Jittery Joe's. On Avery Island gets new cover art for the reissue.

years.h: A Grammy nomination for the Neutral Milk Hotel box
years.p: The Collected Works of Neutral Milk Hotel is nominated for Best Boxed or Special Limited Edition Package at the 66th Grammy Awards.
